The issue in the failing test `testLongLineChunkingIndentIgnored` is related to an infinite loop in the wrapping code of `HelpFormatter`. The test sets up some options with a long description and uses the `HelpFormatter` to print the help message. If the description is too long to fit on a single line, the `HelpFormatter` gets stuck in an infinite loop until it crashes the JVM with an `OutOfMemoryError`.

By examining the `HelpFormatter` class, I found two relevant methods: `printHelp(PrintWriter pw, int width, String cmdLineSyntax, String header, Options options, int leftPad, int descPad, String footer)` and `printHelp(PrintWriter pw, int width, String cmdLineSyntax, String header, Options options, int leftPad, int descPad, String footer, boolean autoUsage)`. These methods are responsible for printing the help message.

The issue seems to be with the wrapping logic in the `HelpFormatter` class, where if a word is too long to fit on a single line, it causes an infinite loop. The recent bug report suggests that the `HelpFormatter` class should handle the word wrapping more efficiently to avoid such infinite loops.

To fix this issue, the wrapping logic in the `HelpFormatter` class needs to be updated to handle long words more gracefully and prevent the infinite loop from occurring.

Next, I will provide the methods that should be fixed to address this issue.
```
org.apache.commons.cli.HelpFormatter.printHelp(java.io.PrintWriter,int,java.lang.String,java.lang.String,org.apache.commons.cli.Options,int,int,java.lang.String)
org.apache.commons.cli.HelpFormatter.printHelp(java.io.PrintWriter,int,java.lang.String,java.lang.String,org.apache.commons.cli.Options,int,int,java.lang.String,boolean)
```

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
